title: ORACLE-SWE: Quantifying the Contribution of Critical Information Signals on SWE Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.07789v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Language Model (LM) agents have increasingly focused on repository-level software engineering (SWE) tasks, leading to various agentic workflows, training methods and failure analysis. Interestingly, rather than directly generating or evaluating edit patches, these approaches first examine and improve intermediate information signals collected during agent exploration, including Reproduction Test, Regression Test, Edit Location, Execution Context, and API Usage. Although different studies examine different subsets of these signals, no work has systematically compared their relative effectiveness in improving final task success or measured the remaining space for improvement in each signal. To address this gap, this work quantifies the contributions of both oracle and agent-extracted signals to final task success and measures the gap between current agent-found signals and their oracle counterparts. translated_title: ORACLE-SWE：量化关键信息信号对软件工程代理的贡献
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）代理的最新进展日益聚焦于仓库级软件工程（SWE）任务，由此产生了多种代理式工作流、训练方法和失败分析技术。有趣的是，这些方法并非直接生成或评估编辑补丁，而是首先检查并改进在代理探索过程中收集到的中间信息信号，包括复现测试、回归测试、编辑位置、执行上下文和API用法。尽管不同的研究考察了这些信号的不同子集，但目前尚无工作系统地比较它们在提升最终任务成功率方面的相对有效性，也没有测量每个信号中还剩余多大的改进空间。为填补这一空白，本工作量化了“神谕”信号与代理提取的信号对最终任务成功的贡献，并测量了当前代理所发现的信号与其对应神谕信号之间的差距。
tldr: 该论文提出ORACLE-SWE，首次系统量化了复现测试、回归测试、编辑位置、执行上下文和API用法等关键中间信息信号对软件工程代理任务成功的贡献，并测量了代理发现的信号与理想神谕信号之间尚存的改进空间。
